description: This file defines a React component for a list page in an admin UI, including features like search, filtering, sorting, pagination, selection, and actions (e.g., delete). It manages state, performs GraphQL queries/mutations, and renders UI elements such as tables, dialogs, and action bars.

methods.name: FilterTag
methods.description: Component displaying a filter tag with optional editing dialog.

methods.name: FilterEdit
methods.description: Component providing UI to edit a filter's value.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters to extract filter objects for the list.

methods.name: getSort
methods.description: Determines sorting descriptor from list metadata and URL query.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Calculates current page number from URL query.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Determines page size from URL query or defaults.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Gets list of columns to display based on URL query.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in message strings with actual values.

methods.name: ActionItemsDialog
methods.description: Component handling execution of batch actions on list items, with success/error handling.
